decisive_spans.text: The biopsy result was interpreted as either prostatic stromal sarcoma or prostatic stromal tumor of uncertain malignant potential

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states that the biopsy result was interpreted as either prostatic stromal sarcoma or prostatic stromal tumor of uncertain malignant potential. This directly contradicts D4 (Phyllodes Tumor of the Prostate) and D6 (Prostatic adenocarcinoma). D3 (Sarcomatoid carcinoma of the prostate) is not directly contradicted by this statement and is supported by the aggressive features and large prostatic mass.
